description: Fresh isolated O3 DSP builds. Default baseline vs monophonic fast path plus indexed command coalescing; SIMD is a separate opt-in experiment.
note: Each focused run uses 100 warmup blocks then 1000 measured blocks, repeated three times. SIMD and single-optimization runs have fewer repetitions than the six-round baseline/candidate groups. Desktop CPU timings exclude browser scheduling.

limitations: Excludes worker messaging, AudioWorklet and OS scheduling.
Over-budget CPU blocks are not measured audio underruns.
128 requested voices tests admission/stealing beyond the 96-voice budget.
